basalt.settings.restart.title: Restart required
basalt.settings.restart.body: Changes take effect after restarting the game.
basalt.option.compactvertex.tooltip: Stores chunk geometry at half the size. +5% FPS.
basalt.option.facecull.tooltip: Skips block faces pointing away from the camera. −22% GPU terrain time.
basalt.option.drawcache.tooltip: Reuses chunk draw lists between frames.
basalt.option.modelpart.tooltip: Faster mob and item model rendering.
basalt.option.presentmode.tooltip: Enables the vsync mode option below.
basalt.option.swapchain.tooltip: Removes hitches when resizing the window.
basalt.option.parallelgen.tooltip: Generates chunks on all cores. +40–55% speed.
basalt.option.poi.tooltip: Faster villager workstation, bed and portal lookups.
basalt.option.fastmap.tooltip: Faster block state property changes, less memory.
basalt.option.vsync_mode.tooltip: FIFO: classic vsync. Mailbox: no tearing, lower latency, but renders up to the framerate limit and drops extra frames (more GPU load and power).
basalt.option.entityculling.max_distance: How far to check whether entities are hidden.
basalt.settings.subtitle: Video Settings
basalt.option.textcache.tooltip: Reuses the glyph layout of sign and name tag text between frames.
basalt.option.tint.tooltip: Reuses biome samples between neighbouring blocks when blending grass, foliage and water colours. ~10% faster chunk meshing.
